(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → Fin 4 → ℤ := fun n k => u (n + k)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (t := Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin 4 => B) (fun _ => T))
    (fun n => ⟨fun k => (hB (n + k)).1, fun k => (hB (n + k)).2⟩)
    (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  have h : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrFun heq ⟨m, hm⟩
      · have hp : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ m → u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by
          intro k hk hkm
          rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc hkm, Nat.add_sub_assoc hkm]
          exact ih (m - k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1,
          hp 1 (by omega) (by omega), hp 2 (by omega) (by omega),
          hp 3 (by omega) (by omega), hp 4 (by omega) (by omega)]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have e := (h (n - i)).symm
  simpa only [show i + (n - i) = n by omega,
    show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) by omega] using e
